answer_2.quote: We compared the performance of BIP-ALM and several state-of-the-art models for text QA or multimodal QA, including GPT-4(V).

answer_4.quote: Human baseline. We conducted a human experiment to validate our questions, and to evaluate human performance. Participants (N=180) were recruited online via Prolific. We randomly sampled 120 questions (20% of all questions) from all types.
answer_4.guideline: Participants answered questions based on typical household activities, selecting the more likely true statement from two options.
